link_notes: CSDI is a time series imputation method (also forecasting), not a synthetic-data generator for release; sources show no synthetic-data use.

open_release.rationale: The paper and README treat CSDI as an imputation method and never frame its output as a shareable synthetic dataset.

pipeline_testing.rationale: Nothing in the sources mentions testing software or pipelines with generated data.

ml_augmentation.rationale: Imputation and forecasting are evaluated by CRPS and MAE; no train-on-synthetic evaluation or augmentation framing.

statistical_replication.rationale: Evaluation measures imputation error (CRPS, MAE), not fidelity of a synthetic dataset to real distributions.

causal_inference.rationale: No DAG, causal or intervention framing appears in the sources.

education.rationale: The README only gives run commands and a visualisation notebook, with no teaching framing.

benchmarking.rationale: CSDI is compared against baselines for imputation; the sources do not show it used as a baseline or benchmark for generators.
